photo.alt: The National Assembly building in Quito

facts: 2,850 m up, in a valley on the slopes of the Pichincha volcano
worth_knowing: Either the highest or second-highest national capital, depending on whether La Paz or Sucre counts for Bolivia. Its historic centre was among the first UNESCO World Cultural Heritage Sites, in 1978.
